headline: Phase 0 (safety net) is about 65% done and the first safety features are now live. All existing modules are working normally.
live_health: Database: working (backup taken before every live change)
Existing modules (leave, attendance, projects, TA, chat and others): not affected
Debug mode on the live server switched off (security improvement)

done_this_update: Released the safety features to the live site: module on/off switch and login protection (verified live, no downtime)
Automatic test checks now run on GitHub for every change; first run passed
Took a fresh live database backup before the release
Earlier today: fixed bug-tracker search on live, turned off debug mode, cleaned leftover files, updated login heading
next: Create the staging (test) copy of the live system and restore a backup there
Add tests for modules that have none
Safer sessions/cache and login token expiry, then a 150-user load test
capacity_answer: The database will not break with 100+ users working at once. The live server is strong (24 processors, 40 GB memory). Improvements planned in Phase 0 (lighter background checks, rate limits, caching) give comfortable room for 150 to 300 users at the same time. A load test will confirm the exact number.

risks.risk: Sessions and cache are stored in the database, adding load per page

risks.risk: Only login has rate limiting so far
risks.action: Add limits for uploads and general use
